entries.title: Psalms 10:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 David complains of the wicked. 12 He prays for remedy. 16 He professes his confidence.

A.M. 3464. B.C. 541. standest. 22:1; 46:1; Jer 14:8 hidest. 13:1-3; 27:9; 30:7; 44:24; 88:14; Job 13:24; 23:9; 34:29

entries.title: Psalms 10:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: boasteth. 35:21; 49:6; 52:1; 73:8,9; 94:4; Ex 15:9; Isa 10:7-11; 37:23 Jas 4:13,16 hearts. Heb. soul's. and blesseth, etc. or, the covetousblesseth himself, he abhorreth the Lord. 49:11-13,18; De 29:19; 1Sa 23:21; Job 31:24; Pr 28:4; Ho 12:7,8 Zec 11:5-8; Lu 12:19; Ro 1:29,32; 2Ti 3:2-4; 1Jo 2:15 whom. Isa 57:17; Jer 22:17; Mic 6:10-12; Hab 2:9; Mt 26:15,16; Lu 12:15 Lu 16:14,15; 1Co 6:10; Eph 5:5; Col 3:5; 1Ti 6:9,10 abhorreth. 5:6; Le 26:30; De 32:19

entries.title: Psalms 10:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the pride. 18:27; 101:5; Pr 6:17; 21:4; 30:13; Isa 2:11; 3:9 will not. 14:2; 27:8; Ex 5:2; De 8:14; Job 22:17; Pr 30:9; Jer 2:31 Da 5:22,23; Zep 2:3 God, etc. or, all his thoughts are, There is no God. 14:1; 53:1; Eph 2:12 thoughts. Ge 6:5; Isa 59:7; 65:2; Jer 4:14; Mr 7:21; Ac 8:22; Ro 1:21,28

entries.title: Psalms 10:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: said. 11:1; 14:1; Mt 24:48 not. 15:5; 30:6; Ec 8:11; Isa 47:7; 56:12; Na 1:10; Mt 24:48; 1Th 5:3 never. Heb. unto generation and generation.

entries.title: Psalms 10:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: sitteth. 1Sa 22:18; 23:23; 2Ki 21:16; Pr 1:11,12; Hab 3:14; Lu 8:1; 10:1 his eyes. 17:11; Pr 6:12,13; Jer 22:17 are privily set. Heb. hide themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 10:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: croucheth. Heb. breaketh himself. 1Sa 2:36 humbleth. 1Sa 18:21-26; 23:21,22; 2Sa 15:5 by his strong ones. Heb. or, into his strong parts.

entries.title: Psalms 10:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Arise. 3:7; 7:6; 9:19 lift. 94:2; Isa 26:11; 33:10; Mic 5:9 forget. 9:12; 13:1; 77:9 humble. or, afflicted.

entries.title: Psalms 10:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Thou hast. 35:22; Pr 15:3; Jer 16:17; 23:24; Heb 4:13 for thou. Hab 1:13 to requite. Jud 1:7; 2Ki 9:26; 2Ch 6:23; Jer 51:56; Joe 3:4 the poor. 55:22; 2Ti 1:12; 1Pe 4:19; 5:7 committeth. Heb. leaveth. Isa 10:3; Jer 49:11 helper. 68:5; 146:9; De 10:18; Ho 14:3
